limitations_and_boundaries: The review notes that many proposed regulatory signals (GPCR, Mevalonate, etc.) lack in vivo evidence and require further genetic analysis in vertebrate models.
The review emphasizes that the physiological relevance of many cell culture findings remains unclear until tested in vivo in both flies and mice.
